## Quality Checklist

- [ ] This is the smallest clear change that solves the problem.
- [ ] High-risk files did not grow unnecessary branching or mixed responsibilities.
- [ ] Comments explain why a decision exists, not what obvious code does.
- [ ] Tests would fail without this change.
- [ ] Docs and generated workflow examples match actual CLI behavior.

## Integrity And Reporting

- [ ] No silent PASS path was introduced.
- [ ] Invalid JSON, dropped findings, reviewer failures, and Chair failures remain visible.
- [ ] Reporter parity was checked when output fields changed.
- [ ] Security claims include an exploit path or are warning-level only.
